conclusions: High, Long, and Insane dispatch to Pipeline<double> at the audited revision.
Standard, Short, Fast, and Lightning dispatch to Pipeline<float> and are refuted for the strong Binary64 contract only.
The audited double path reads and writes IEEE Float64 directly and keeps the inspected signal path templated on the same REAL type.
The floating path bypasses integer dither/quantization; normalization is not an admitted CLI mode.

Revision 6b0bbfe1 keeps src/ at the audited base b769add0 and applies patches/ssrc-tonepoet-finite-stream.patch in patchPhase (flake.nix). The patch touches src/libshibatchdsp/FastPP.hpp, SRC.hpp, xdr_wav.h and the tester only: floating RIFF/Wave64/RF64 output gains a fact chunk backpatched at close, and linear-phase conversion publishes the finite timeline round(N*Fd/Fs) by discarding exactly latencyFrames derived on the integer LCM clock. Filter coefficients, DFT/SLEEF arithmetic, dither, and Pipeline<double> dispatch are unchanged, so the DFT type-path audit below carries over.

ObjectCache.hpp:46-58: constructSleefDFT<T> is SFINAE-restricted to T=double or T=float and calls SleefDFT_double_init1d for double (line 48) and SleefDFT_float_init1d for float (line 53); no other DFT constructor exists in the audited tree.

DFTFilter.hpp:42-43, PartDFTFilter.hpp:82-83, PartDFTFilterMT.hpp:82-83: every DFT plan is constructed via constructSleefDFT<REAL> with the enclosing filter's own REAL template parameter; buffers are REAL (DFTFilter.hpp:32,45) and executed with SleefDFT_execute on those buffers, so a Pipeline<double> never constructs or executes a float DFT.

cli.cpp:803-812: profile.doublePrecision selects Pipeline<double>; the built-in high, long, and insane profiles carry doublePrecision=true, standard/short/fast/lightning carry false. Ad-hoc numeric profiles ending in 'd' also select double but are outside the qualified scope.

CMakeLists.txt:106-137: SLEEF is built from submodules/sleef via ExternalProject with -DSLEEF_BUILD_DFT=True -DSLEEF_ENFORCE_DFT=True and linked as static sleefdft/sleef/tlfloat; SLEEF_GIT_TAG is 0c063a8f0e01c22fa1e473effd2e7a0c69b4963a (line 109).

flake.nix:14-20 declares sleefSrc = fetchFromGitHub shibatch/sleef rev 0c063a8f0e01c22fa1e473effd2e7a0c69b4963a sha256-BM88tQAImtQuKKBSPT0hE659cfe6FVzxKSF3TSrbknk= fetchSubmodules=true; the commissioned derivation's preConfigure copies that fetched source into submodules/sleef before configure, so the ExternalProject path (CMakeLists.txt:128) is the one taken.

The commissioned executable has no dynamic SLEEF dependency (ldd lists only glibc libm/libc) and embeds sleef_internal and SleefDFT symbols, consistent with the static submodule build; the nixpkgs sleef-4.0.0 in buildInputs is not what the executable links.
